scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Discounted risk-neutral expectation of positive terminal stock-strike payoff
scientific_intent.numerical_method: 2048-step recombining Cox–Ross–Rubinstein-style binomial tree; no early exercise
scientific_intent.community_use: Compare backward-tree parallelization and Float32 discrete pricing against an independently evaluated terminal expectation
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All 145 prices checked individually against Float64 direct binomial expectation for exact serialized Float32 coefficients; continuous Black–Scholes error reported separately
limitations: Named 16/129 option batches; original1024-option CLI not measured
Rounded coefficients and finite2048-step discretization differ from continuous Black–Scholes; no calibrated financial-market accuracy claim
